title: How would I switch a character sprite when its on region tile using Yanflys plugins?

posts.author: paragram
posts.body:
I am wondering how to switch a characters sprite to a more transparent sprite when they walk over a region tile. For context, I have a parallax map, and I am using the Yanfly Region Restrictions to control where the player can move. Since the map is an image, I m trying to figure out how to make the character semi-transparent every time it walks over a certain region to simulate them going under objects such as bridges or trees. I am trying to use Yanflys Event Region Trigger to accomplish this but I'm not sure how to set it up .
If anyone has any tips or can help me figure this out, that would be most appreciated
Spoiler:
Here is a image of how my setup looks
Region tile 6 is where the player sprite has no transparency whereas region tile 7 is where I want to apply roughly 50% transparency to the player icon.
Spoiler:
event setup so far
Here is what I have setup on an event that gets called at the start of the game. I know this doesn't work but I am at a loss of how to go about this

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body:
Since you are working with the event region trigger plugin, I would set up the event a bit differently:
First set it to player touch, instead of parallel. Then use the comment command and put <Region Trigger: 7> in it. Then you can do your change actor image command to set it to the transparent one, but without the conditional branch.
The same you do with a second event for region 6, changing the image back to the normal one and putting <Region Trigger: 6> into the comment.
